parameters.content:
## Approved Delivery (Phase 2 Demo)

**Pattern:** Webhook → Load state → Classify → (committed → existing) | (candidate → Assert → CRM) | (else → refused)

- CRM delivery is reachable ONLY through the Assert Approved Code node — its sole immediate predecessor. That node throws unless the review is exactly approved by a separately recorded reviewer action, the delivery is pending/retryable, the stable CRM idempotency key matches, and the canonical payload hash recomputed in-graph matches the recorded hash.
- A committed delivery returns the existing sanitized effect on a branch with NO edge to the assertion or CRM — replay changes nothing.
- Pending, rejected, unknown, conflicting, malformed, and garbage states terminate at a truthful refusal before the CRM node.
- The single CRM HTTP node is the local counted boundary at http://mock-api:9090 with fictional Greenfield & Associates data only; no other CRM route exists in any gated graph.

## State Contract

- Load: POST /demo/v1/delivery/state with review_id — returns the sanitized review (state + recorded approval), the delivery record, and the raw fictional payload ONLY for approved+pending reviews
- Assert: exact approved state, reviewer-recorded approval, pending/retryable delivery, crmkey_<review_id>, in-graph SHA-256 of the canonical payload, required contact fields
- Refusals are truthful 409 responses; a Code-node throw stops the workflow before CRM on any path that somehow reaches the assertion non-approved
- CRM outcome: only an explicit committed/exists effect answers delivered. A pre-commit application failure (HTTP 200, committed:false, retryable:true) answers crm_failed_retryable — the attempt is journaled, no effect exists, and exactly one deliberate same-key retry commits the single effect. Response-loss-after-commit and process-restart semantics are NOT implemented and NOT claimed.
